page_title: RSO 1-1 ALA | Real Sociedad v Alaves 02/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+11' That's it for today, Victor Garcia has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+10' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
90+9' The resulting corner from Javi Lopez (Alaves) is cleared by the defence.
90+8' Although Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is just on the bench, Victor Garcia has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+6' 1 - 1 Goal! Mikel Merino slips it to Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 1:1.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Xeber Alkain (Alaves) replaces Luis Rioja.
90+5' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Antonio Sivera keeps it out.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Takefusa Kubo and he is replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
90+3' The referee signals a substitution. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Kieran Tierney.
90+3' Kike Garcia (Alaves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

90+3' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a precise pass from his teammate and sends a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, his aim was a bit off and the ball flies just narrowly over the crossbar.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' NO PENALTY! Referee Victor Garcia has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Real Sociedad players are incensed.
89' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Real Sociedad as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
87' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.

87' Rafa Marin (Alaves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Real Sociedad after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
86' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) replacing Mikel Oyarzabal.
86' A substitution has been made. Brais Mendez goes off and Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) comes on.
84' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

83' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
82' Javi Lopez (Alaves) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
80' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
78' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
76' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Luis Rioja (Alaves) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Unai Marrero no chance!
75' Luis Rioja (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
74' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.

74' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Alaves.

73' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
73' Poor challenge! Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) is penalised for tripping and Victor Garcia blows his whistle.
71' Having seen unsporting behavior, Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) is the recipient.
70' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Jon Guridi is replaced by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
70' Substitution. Samu Omorodion leaves the pitch and is replaced by Giuliano Simeone (Alaves).
68' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
68' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
66' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
65' Javi Lopez (Alaves) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
64' Real Sociedad string together a series of short passes.
62' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
61' The attendance is 34051.
59' Caution goes to Samu Omorodion (Alaves).
57' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Kike Garcia (Alaves) replaces Abderrahmane Rebbach.
57' The game has come to an end for Antonio Blanco. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
55' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
55' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
54' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) steps up to send the ball in.
53' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
52' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
51' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
51' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
50' Looks like Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
50' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
50' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
49' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
47' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Referee Victor Garcia blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Victor Garcia blows his whistle as Antonio Blanco (Alaves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
45+2' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
43' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
42' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
41' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes a short run up and tries to place the ball from the free kick, but the defensive wall blocks the effort.
40' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
39' Forced substitution due to red card. Unai Marrero joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andre Silva (Real Sociedad).
36' An early bath for Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad). He receives a red card from Victor Garcia. His teammates will not thank him after the match.

36' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

35' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Brais Mendez wasn't able to finish and lost the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
34' Javi Lopez (Alaves) sends a long ball in, but Alex Remiro comfortably gathers the ball.
32' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
31' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) is furious with himself. He latches onto a rebound on the edge of the box and directs a header just over the crossbar!
29' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
28' A long pass, executed by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad), missed the precision to reach his teammates.

27' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Garcia with no other option than to blow for a foul.
25' A pass by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Ander Guevara (Alaves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
21' A cross is whipped into the box by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) and Andre Silva controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
20' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
19' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
18' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
18' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
15' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
14' Jon Guridi (Alaves) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
13' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
12' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) took the corner.
12' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.

10' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
8' A rebound falls kindly for Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
7' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
6' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
5' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) launches a cross from the corner, but Antonio Sivera is alert to thwart the effort.
5' A pass from Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
4' The Real Sociedad players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Good movement by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
1' A long ball forward to Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) is intercepted.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will officiate today.
